subject: Erika Reinfeld School Committee Candidacy
overview: School Committee candidate Erika Reinfeld discussed her platform of curriculum, culture, and community during an interview with Medford Bites. She highlighted priorities including budget transparency, diverse representation in learning materials, and expanded interdisciplinary programs.

items.title: Favorite Local Business
items.summary: Erika Reinfeld identified Goldilocks as a favorite local eatery and discussed her preference for their breakfast sandwiches.

items.title: Motivation for Candidacy
items.summary: Reinfeld described her transition into local politics based on her professional career in education and her observations as a Medford Public Schools parent.

items.title: Platform and School Culture
items.summary: The candidate defined her primary goals as improving school culture and social-emotional support through a framework of curriculum, culture, and community.

items.title: Curriculum Representation and Student Collaboration
items.summary: Reinfeld advocated for diversifying representation in school materials and increasing cross-grade collaboration, such as having older students mentor younger ones in STEM and art.

items.title: Budget and Community Resources
items.summary: She addressed the need for transparent communication regarding the school budget and proposed formalizing partnerships with local biotech and arts organizations.

items.title: Interdisciplinary and Service Learning
items.summary: The candidate promoted interdisciplinary learning and the removal of financial barriers to extracurricular activities like theater and sports.

items.title: Personal Background and Campaign Events
items.summary: Reinfeld shared personal background regarding her education in theater and astronomy and announced upcoming candidate meet-and-greet events at Fulton Heights and Colleen's.
